display_name: ONNX-ASR (bsc lt los conformer transducer large)
description: Runs ASR models exported to ONNX through the onnx-asr library, without a PyTorch dependency. This fighter runs bsc-lt-los-conformer-transducer-large (nemo-conformer-rnnt), covering es.
notes: Model from the OpenVoiceOS 'stt-asr-onnx' HuggingFace collection.
